name: real-scene-validation
scope: 266 distinct real-scene target positions: 250 base queries (four conveyor contacts corrected), plus 12 multi-box and 4 circular-waterwheel acceptance cases. No generated worlds.
selectionPolicy: Retained cases keep failures. New selection uses authored inputs and source geometry, not new solver results.
executionStatus: NOT RUN: input selection and source-reference audit only; no new TS/Rust or alpha77 comparison.

preparation.defaultPhysical: full-scene-navigation plus on-demand source collision; no completed-route cache
preparation.defaultWorldState: terminal/completed progression; facilities assumed enabled; teleports assumed unlocked unless query says otherwise
preparation.perCaseSetup: Apply setup before preparation. Recursively merge locomotionPatch into source locomotion. Respect capped physical mode. Reject unsupported setup; never silently ignore it.
preparation.goals: Preserve query.goal and interaction exactly. Start projection needs a physical support witness; it must not rewrite the goal.
preparation.devices: Use source movement-settings-current.json and traversal export. Normalized device facts are selection evidence only.

feasibility: independent capsule collision/support replay against original source geometry
explicit first valid goal event in original interaction volume including airborne/facing constraints
continuous position/time/control and whole-route stamina/dash/boost accounting
no partial, coverage-limited or timed-out result classified complete
acceptance.exercise: Report a separate exercised/not-exercised result for each exercise assertion. A valid alternative does not establish mechanism coverage.
acceptance.comparison: Same inputs, setup, budgets and cache conditions; compare gained/lost valid solutions first. Cost may regress at most 5% on independently valid common solutions.
acceptance.cleanup: Close owned browser pages and terminate owned profiler/worker processes after every profile batch. Do not stop unrelated development services.

excludedScope: Moving-platform phase synchronization and waiting are explicitly excluded by the user; they are not acceptance gaps.
amendments: Original conveyor cases v250-184 through v250-187 now use contacts within one source-derived fixed box pose. This replaces long sweep-face contact queries under the corrected stepping-box contract. Other query definitions are unchanged.

supportPolicy.vertical: Source pose caps plus validated bidirectional ride connections, without a fictitious shaft wall.
supportPolicy.nonVertical: Phase-free swept roof support plus validated timed transfers when a source speed exists; swept space is not a solid obstacle.
supportPolicy.followingBox: Each selected placement must obey its source activity sphere and supported/collision-free geometry. Unselected source boxes remain present.
supportPolicy.multiBox: One coherent joint layout must actually support all counted box uses. The TS prototype searches bounded joint layouts; Rust automatic discovery remains single-box. Full real-scene acceptance is pending.
supportPolicy.conveyor: Swept support locates candidate poses. Each stepping use must admit one fixed source-derived box pose covering its full contact run. Display only that used box pose; source speed is not required for this phase-free stepping model.
supportPolicy.waterwheel: Previously agreed traversable circular-surface model, allowing player adjustment on blades while preserving source axis/pivot/radius, external obstacles and entry checks. Exported terminal-pose geometry is not an implementation of this model.

modelLimits: Selection-time capability gap: Multi-box joint placement is a required capability gap, now represented by 12 acceptance cases; proximity does not prove necessity or feasibility.
Selection-time capability gap: Waterwheel reachable-domain support is a required capability gap, represented by four source-animated wheel cases.
Following-box carrying/activation time is outside the present placement model.
Authored source/runtime progression and actual player traversal still require separate confirmation.
Coarse navigation, historical completion and stair labels are selection evidence, not current physical validation.
Exported navigation interfaces have reverse edges. One-way-only navigation passage coverage is not established; rope ascent/descent requests retain their separate directions.

distribution.legacyObservationScope: Previous observations are from the retained pre-Rust comparison, not a fresh run of this suite.
distribution.adaptationNotes: selectionCapabilityGap records the pre-prototype selection state, not the current implementation. Do not silently relabel old exports as new inputs.
